adapterId.description: The adapter id of the object being converted to mapped object.
adapterId.label: Adapter Id

adapterTypeSpecific.description: This is the adapterTypeSpecific parameter value.
adapterTypeSpecific.label: Adapter Specific

objectType.description: The object type of the object being converted to mapped object.
objectType.label: Object Type

useDefaultProcessing.description: Return this value to cause default map-and-forward processing. Default processing requires mappedAdapterId on the model adapter conf; without it, an error is thrown.
useDefaultProcessing.label: Use Default Processing

mappedAdapterId.description: The model adapter conf mappedAdapterId, when configured. Undefined/nullish when the model adapter omits mappedAdapterId (pure-script models that implement used operations in on* hooks).
mappedAdapterId.label: Mapped Adapter Id

mappedObjectType.description: The object type of the object being converted to object.
mappedObjectType.label: Mapped Object Type
